description: This file contains functions and logic for generating and managing the admin UI in a KeystoneJS project, including file operations, directory cleanup, and dynamic import path serialization.

methods.name: serializePathForImport
methods.description: Serializes a filesystem path into a JSON string suitable for use in import statements, escaping Windows paths and removing file extensions.

methods.name: writeAdminFile
methods.description: Writes or copies an admin file to the specified project path, creating directories as needed, and reading existing content to determine if an update is necessary.

methods.name: generateAdminUI
methods.description: Main function to generate the admin UI, including cleaning directories, writing user files, adding page files, and cleaning up obsolete files during live reloads.
